title: hieracium graecum subsp. cyllenium
intro: Hieracium graecum subsp. cyllenium, commonly known as Cyllene hawk's beard or Kri-kri hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to Greece. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium graecum subsp. cyllenium include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal properties, making it useful for treating skin infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
